description: An agent implements a task, a command checks it; a failed check goes back to a fresh agent with the log (3 tries), then a rescue on Opus.

inputs.name: task
inputs.label: Task
inputs.description: What to build or fix, in plain words.

inputs.name: check
inputs.label: Check
inputs.description: The shell command that proves the work, for example the tests. Exit 0 passes.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: What the agent reports it did.

nodes.label: Implement
Check
nodes.command:
# The input `check` arrives as an environment variable: run it as a shell command.
sh -c "{{check}}"

nodes.label: Rescue
